exceptions.finding: Admin Users creates/reuses fi_users plus fi_tenant_admin_users and explicitly supports operational staff while not creating fi_staff. The repository does not enforce that a clinic employee is represented only through Team.
exceptions.requiredResolution: Add read-only overlap audit and approved classification/migration plan before enforcing or removing any identity.

exceptions.finding: /team/identity and /workforce-os/staff-access reuse StaffAccessCentreClient but use different route gates.
exceptions.requiredResolution: Prove or deliberately reconcile gate equivalence before redirect.

exceptions.finding: /staff versus /team/staff and /audit versus /reports/quality share views but differ in PIN-prefix or PIN-friendly layout behaviour.
exceptions.requiredResolution: Equalise PIN/portal gates before any redirect; keep both pairs HOLD until proven.

exceptions.finding: ConnectExistingSystemsPanel is mounted in tenant Configuration and platform Onboarding against the same records/actions; HubSpot connector controls also appear in the provider workspace.
exceptions.requiredResolution: Deployment rebuild must convert Configuration/Onboarding to summary/link behaviour; Integrations remains the sole native editor owner.

exceptions.finding: Integrations page reachability uses Configuration-hub capability, while Google mutation APIs allow operations_admin. Finance can open the page but fail Google mutations; operations_admin can mutate but cannot reach the page.
exceptions.requiredResolution: Reconcile page reachability and API authorisation before changing Google UI ownership or controls.

exceptions.finding: Active Front Desk redirects preserve only bookingId and date, while older plans expected patientId and demo as well.
exceptions.requiredResolution: Document actual preserved keys and restore patientId/demo only if live deep links require them.

exceptions.finding: Team legacy catalog and Team Training page link to tenant /academy, but no tenant page exists.
exceptions.requiredResolution: Remove from active approved navigation in 2C after reference scan; keep Team training.

exceptions.finding: reception-os, workforce/hr and several surgery/finance routes remain live with distinct loaders, mutations or gates.
exceptions.requiredResolution: Use HOLD/LINK dispositions until parity and deep-link inventories are complete.

exceptions.finding: Platform deployment routes exist, but the proposed tenant More → Deployment destination is not yet a proven tenant route.
exceptions.requiredResolution: Define route and lifecycle/RBAC contract in the Deployment rebuild; do not add a dead More item in 2C.

exceptions.finding: LeadFlow and consultation-conversion redirects intentionally drop all query parameters; stale guides and revalidation paths still mention the aliases.
exceptions.requiredResolution: Inventory remaining references and restore query forwarding only if required.

blockers: PIN-prefix or PIN-friendly layout parity blocks redirecting /staff and /audit.
Admin Users permits non-fi_staff operational identities and lacks a no-employee-duplication invariant.
Connector editing is duplicated across Configuration, Platform Onboarding and provider workspaces.
Google Calendar page reachability and mutation authorisation disagree by role.
Tenant Deployment destination and lifecycle visibility are not implemented, so it cannot yet be an active More link.
Live legacy workspace parity is incomplete for reception-os, workforce/hr, procedure-day and some surgery routes.
